overview_description.description: Chariot is building financial infrastructure for the $326 billion donor-advised fund market, the fastest-growing segment of philanthropy. DAFpay by Chariot is the industry’s first DAF payment option and was named one of TIME’s Best Inventions of 2025. Backed by Maveron, Y Combinator, SV Angel, and Spark Capital, Chariot's team is committed to empowering nonprofits to achieve their visions.

product.name: DAFpay
product.description: An express checkout tool that enables donors to give using their Donor Advised Funds directly through nonprofit donation forms with minimal clicks.

product.name: Chariot Disbursements
product.description: A platform for payers to validate, verify, and electronically disburse grant payments to nonprofits with standardized gift details and compliance.

product.name: DAF Scan
product.description: A service that scans and identifies address inconsistencies and missing listings of nonprofits across major Donor Advised Fund providers to prevent lost donations.
